meta.title: About — SimplyFoot
meta.description: The story, conviction and five founders of SimplyFoot. Born on a Saturday morning at the touchline.

hero.subtitle: Five people passionate about amateur football who decided their sport deserved its own tool.

paragraphs: It's 8:30 AM, a cold Saturday morning in November. The pitch is soaked. Parents blow into their hands while the U11s warm up.
Romain is there, as he is every weekend. Phone in hand, scrolling three WhatsApp groups: 'Is the match still on?', 'My son can't make it', 'Which pitch again?'.
The coach is trying to figure out how many players he'll have for the 10 AM match. He sent the call-ups on Tuesday evening by SMS. Three parents haven't replied. Two replied in the wrong group.
The chairman, meanwhile, is at home with a binder, a spreadsheet and a headache. 200 members. 16 teams. Unpaid fees to chase.
Everyone gets by with string, goodwill and countless volunteer hours. That Saturday, Romain thinks: 'There must be a better way.'

act2.titleBefore: What if we built the tool we
body: The idea didn't come from an office. It came from the touchline. Romain talked to Jean. Jean knew the problem by heart. They talked to Jérémy, who knew dozens of clubs in the same situation. Vanessa brought the perspective: 'If we do this, it has to genuinely serve people.'
SimplyFoot was born from a simple conviction: amateur football deserves its own tool.

act3.titleBefore: We're not building an app. We're building a
act3.body: Damien joins the adventure. Every screen is designed, debated, tested. Rule number one: if the chairman of your village club doesn't understand the interface in ten seconds, it has failed. Every feature comes from a real question asked by a real volunteer, a real coach, a real chairman.
quotes: What do I do when parents are separated?
How do I move a match time at the last minute?
How do I know who's coming without calling everyone?
How do I manage 16 teams without losing my mind?

team.subtitle: Five people, one shared belief: amateur football deserves better.

romain.spirit: The brain and heart of the project. Passionate about amateur football since childhood, he saw the problem before anyone else.

jean.spirit: The man on the ground. He knows by heart the volunteers, the coaches giving up weekends, the treasurers performing miracles.

jeremy.spirit: The connector. He weaves links between people, ideas, opportunities. So nobody feels alone facing the tool.

vanessa.spirit: Rigour and sensitivity. She carries the structure of the project and understands parents, families, those who live the sport from the stands.

damien.spirit: The hands that build. He turns vision into clear screens for a 60-year-old chairman as for a 16-year-old player.

manifesto.kid: It's the 6-year-old touching their first ball.
manifesto.coach: It's the volunteer coach planning sessions after work.
manifesto.parent: It's the parent driving 45 minutes on a Sunday morning.
manifesto.canteen: It's the clubhouse. The chips. The laughter.

firstPerson.heading: We come from that world.
firstPerson.body: We live it. We know it. We love it.

promises: Stay at the service of clubs. Not the other way around.
Build with you. Not for you.
act5.signature: SimplyFoot — five people who said one Saturday morning: amateur football deserves better.

meta.title: SimplyFoot FAQ — Frequently asked questions
meta.description: Find answers to all your questions about SimplyFoot.

faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.subtitle: Find answers to all your questions about SimplyFoot

whatIs.a: SimplyFoot is a mobile application 100% dedicated to amateur football. It allows clubs to manage their squads, call-ups, events, communication and budget in a single tool.

whoFor.a: SimplyFoot is designed for everyone involved in amateur football: presidents, coaches, players and parents. Each profile has its own dedicated area.

whichSports.q: Does SimplyFoot work for other sports?
whichSports.a: SimplyFoot is designed exclusively for amateur football. Other applications (SimplyRugby, SimplyHandball) are being developed for other sports.

howDifferent.q: How is SimplyFoot different from SportEasy or Spond?
howDifferent.a: SimplyFoot is 100% dedicated to amateur football, with specific features such as native multi-role, separated parents management, and complete club management tools.

howRegister.a: Download the SimplyFoot app, create your account with your email, and choose your role (president, coach, player or parent).

joinClub.q: How do I join my club?
joinClub.a: Your coach or president will send you an invitation link or code. You can join the club directly from the app.

createClub.q: How do I create my club?
createClub.a: When signing up as a president, you can create your club, add teams and invite your members.

multiRole.a: Yes! SimplyFoot supports native multi-role. You can be a coach on Tuesday, player on Saturday and parent on Sunday. Switch between your profiles in one click.

howSend.q: How do I send a call-up?
howSend.a: From your coach area, select an event, choose the players to call up (all or targeted) and send. Players receive a push notification.

respond.q: How do I respond to a call-up?
respond.a: In one click from the notification or app: Attending, Absent, or Going directly.

track.a: The coach sees in real time the number of attending, absent and pending for each event (e.g. 12/14 attending).

recurring.a: Yes! Create a recurring training session and it will be automatically duplicated every week. You can modify or cancel each occurrence individually.

separated.q: How does separated parents management work?
separated.a: Each child has a unique linking code. Each parent creates their own account and links their child via this code. Two independent accounts, zero duplicates, zero password sharing.

linkChild.q: How do I link my child to my account?
linkChild.a: Your coach or the club president will provide you with your child's unique linking code. Enter this code in the app to link your child to your account.

bothSee.q: Do both parents see the same information?
bothSee.a: Yes, both parents have access to the same information (calendar, call-ups, messaging) independently.

howWorks.a: Messaging is inspired by WhatsApp. You have club, team and private conversations. The parent's name is always displayed alongside the child's name to avoid confusion.

channels.a: Three levels: Club (all members), Team (players and staff of a team), and Private (one-on-one with a member).

notifications.a: You receive push notifications for new messages, call-ups and events. The bell in the app centralizes all your notifications.

whatManage.q: What can a president do in SimplyFoot?
whatManage.a: The president has a club overview: number of registered players, teams, attendance rate, budget, and can manage members, create teams and oversee club life.

budget.q: Can I manage the club budget?
budget.a: Yes, the president area includes a budget module to track club finances. Advanced accounting features (subscriptions, reminders, receipts) are available in the Club OS Pro plan.

teams.q: How do I manage multiple teams?
teams.a: Create as many teams as needed (U6 to Seniors). Each team has its own coaches, players, events and messaging.

free.a: Yes! The Free version includes scheduling, call-ups, basic communication and basic lineup. It's enough to get started with your club.

packs.a: Three plans: Coach (advanced tools for coaches), Club OS (club management for presidents) and Club OS Pro (automations, accounting, priority support). Prices depend on club size.

payment.a: Payment is monthly, with no commitment. No credit card required for the free version. You can change plans or cancel at any time.

whatIs.a: The pilot program allows test clubs to discover SimplyFoot early and participate in its development by providing their feedback and suggestions.

howJoin.q: How do I join the pilot program?
howJoin.a: Contact us at contact@simplyfoot.fr or at 06 99 94 88 66. We will guide you through installation and getting started.

reinstall.q: Will I need to reinstall the app?
reinstall.a: The next major version will require a new installation and re-registration. This will be the only and last time. After that, all updates will be automatic.

contact.a: By email at contact@simplyfoot.fr or by phone at 06 99 94 88 66. Our team responds within 24 hours.

bug.q: How do I report a bug?
bug.a: Use the contact form with the subject 'Report a bug' or send an email to contact@simplyfoot.fr with a detailed description and screenshots if possible.

updates.q: How often is the app updated?
updates.a: SimplyFoot is updated every 2 weeks with new features and improvements, based on feedback from pilot clubs.
